_comment: ComfyUI API-format workflow for the LoRA decay series (2026-07-28).
API format (flat dict keyed by node id, each with class_type + inputs) --
NOT the UI 'workflow.json' you get from Save in the web editor. This is
what POST /prompt expects, and what logic/comfy_client.queue_workflow()
already sends. If you edit this in the ComfyUI UI, re-export via
'Save (API Format)' or the node ids below will stop matching.
Only vanilla nodes are used -- no custom node packs to install.
Node ids that logic/lora_decay_series.py patches by name:
1  CheckpointLoaderSimple : ckpt_name  (base model)
2  LoraLoader             : lora_name, strength_model, strength_clip
3  CLIPTextEncode         : text       (positive prompt)
4  CLIPTextEncode         : text       (negative prompt)
5  EmptyLatentImage       : width, height
6  KSampler               : seed, steps, cfg, sampler_name, scheduler
8  SaveImage              : filename_prefix
The step-0 baseline is rendered by setting strength_model/strength_clip
to 0 rather than by deleting node 2. Keeping the graph topology byte-
identical across every frame means the only thing changing in the series
is the LoRA itself -- delete the node and you have also changed the
execution path, which is a second variable you did not intend.
